newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee prices higher with futures.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee prices higher with futures.

text.p: Arabicas in the Bremen physical coffee market were marked up $2-11 per 50 kg fob on the week along with firmer futures, traders said on Friday.
The spot December contract in New York posted sharp gains this week amid ongoing concerns about near-term supplies.

Brazils again bucked the firmer price trend and physical differentials eased while Colombians and Central Americans attracted interest for early 1997 despite firmer differentials and African arabicas also found takers at higher prices.
Indonesian robustas rose $7 to $68 cif in sympathy with arabicas but robusta supply was plentiful, also from Vietnam.
